scripts.predeploy: npm run build && cp package.json package-lock.json dist/
scripts.deploy:dev:discordProxy: npm run predeploy && cd dist && gcloud functions deploy discordProxy --gen2 --runtime=nodejs24 --region=us-central1 --source=. --entry-point=discordProxy --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --project=serverless-felix-dev
scripts.deploy:dev:workerDraw: npm run predeploy && cd dist && gcloud functions deploy workerDraw --gen2 --runtime=nodejs24 --region=us-central1 --source=. --entry-point=workerDraw --trigger-topic=jobs --project=serverless-felix-dev
